entry.title: Omni Sampler 1.8.1
entry.summary: ## Omni Sampler 1.8.1 ### New - **Korg Wavestation**: EX waves, all-data dumps, multi-bank files, split cards and VS single-cycle waves. - **Wavetables**: Surge/Bitwig `.wt` and chunkless WAV wavetables (Serum, WaveEdit). - **Ensoniq SD-1 / VFX-SD**: SysEx programs, played from the instrument's wave ROMs. - **Gen2 support**: a new `aarch64` build for 64-bit MPCs (MPC Live III, MPC XL and kin). entry.title: Omni Sampler 1.8.0
entry.summary: See README for the 1.8.0 changes: Korg M1 / M1R / M1EX SysEx played from the M1 sample ROM dumps or Korg's M1 disk (programs, combinations, drum kits, all-data dumps, Plus+1 card), Korg TRITON content dumps and TRINITY banks, Trinity/Triton KMP/KSF/KSC, Ensoniq EPS/ASR disks, Yamaha Motif/Montage libraries, Logic EXS24, BIN/CUE images, FX page, browser groups and faster loading of big folders. Tested on MPC Live II.
